xmldoc.short_description: Create calendar durations with month, day, and time components.

syntax.syntax_item: c = calendarDuration(y, mo, d, h, mi, s)

param_input_item.param_description: Calendar years, months, days, and optional time components, or numeric arrays.

param_output_item.param_description: A calendarDuration array storing months, days, seconds, and a display format.

description.p: Create calendar durations with month, day, and time components.
Calendar durations preserve calendar semantics when added to datetimes. Month-based arithmetic clamps dates to month ends when needed.
Array-valued inputs keep their data shape when the operation supports arrays. Scalar operands are expanded where the implementation defines scalar expansion.
